title: CurrentLevelSummary
description: Summary of the current level of a member

programId.description:
Id of the program.
WARNING: Don't use this for matching with a specific program, since it may vary across environments. 
Use "programReference" instead.

programReference.description:
Reference to the program.
This is a unique reference that is the same in all environments, and can be used to identify the program.
Nullable for backwards compatibility reasons. Should be filled out in most cases.

memberId.description: Id of the member within the program. Can be used to look up more information about the member.

currentRewards.description: The current rewards the member has achieved in the program

pointDefinitionStatuses.description: The current status of each point definition in the program

cappingAmount.description: The amount that this point definition is capped at

isReached.description: Whether the capping amount has been reached by the member

CappingStatus.description: The capping status for this point definition, if capping is enabled

startOfPeriod.description: The start of the period for which the current points are valid

endOfPeriod.description: The end of the period for which the current points are valid

CurrentPointsPeriod.description:
The period for which the current points are valid. Only filled out if the point definition is periodic.
Can return the first active period after the queried time if there is no period active at that point.

CurrentReward.description: The current rewards the member has achieved in the program

levelId.description: Id of the level in the reward ladder

LevelStatus.description: The current level in the reward ladder the member has achieved

pointDefinitionReference.description:
Unique reference for the point. Meant to be used to identify what kind of point this is, across different environments
where the id might be different. This enables clients of the api to enrich the presentation of the point definition,
beyond what this api delivers (for example giving the point definition an icon, or more descriptive text).

pointDefinitionSingularName.description: Singular name of the point definition

pointDefinitionPluralName.description: Plural name of the point definition

currentPoints.description: The amount of points the member currently has of this point definition

pendingPoints.description:
The amount of points the member has received, but are not valid yet.
If the point definition is periodic, this field will only contain the pending points in the current point period.

PointDefinitionStatus.description: The current status of a point definition in a program for a member

referenceId.description: The reference id of the suspension

SuspensionStatusType.description:
The type of suspension:
        - Rewards: Member is suspended from receiving rewards
        - GivePointsEffect: Member is suspended from being given points
        - ConsumePointsEffect: Member is suspended from using points
        - UpdateMemberMetadata: Member is suspended from updating their metadata. 
        - SuspendRewardsEffect: Member is suspended from being put into reward suspension
        - SuspendEffectEffect: Member is suspended from being put into effect suspension
